verses.text: Blessed be Jehovah my rock, Who teacheth my hands to war, And my fingers to fight:

segments.text: Blessed be Jehovah my rock,
Who teacheth my hands to war,
And
my fingers to fight:

verses.text: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.

segments.text: My lovingkindness, and my fortress,
My high tower, and my deliverer;
My shield, and he in whom I take refuge;
Who subdueth my people under me.

verses.text: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

segments.text: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him?
Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

verses.text: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.

segments.text: Man is like to vanity:
His days are as a shadow that passeth away.

verses.text: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

segments.text: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down:
Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.text: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out thine arrows, and discomfit them.

segments.text: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them;
Send out thine arrows, and discomfit them.

verses.text: Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;

segments.text: Stretch forth thy hand from above;
Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters,
Out of the hand of aliens;

verses.text: Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

segments.text: Whose mouth speaketh deceit,
And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.text: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

segments.text: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God:
Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

verses.text: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings; Who rescueth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

segments.text: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings;
Who rescueth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

verses.text: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens, Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

segments.text: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens,
Whose mouth speaketh deceit,
And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.text: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth, And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;

segments.text: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth,
And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;

verses.text: When our garners are full, affording all manner of store, And our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;

segments.text: When
our garners are full, affording all manner of store,

verses.text: When our oxen are well laden; When there is no breaking in, and no going forth, And no outcry in our streets:

segments.text: When
our oxen are well laden;
When there is
no breaking in, and no going forth,

verses.text: Happy is the people that is in such a case; Yea, happy is the people whose God is Jehovah.
